title: Vectors that feel built-in
hints: `@dataclass(frozen=True)` gives you `__init__`, `__eq__`, `__hash__` and immutability for free. You still write `__add__`, `__sub__`, `__mul__`, `__rmul__`, `__abs__`, `__bool__` and `__repr__`.

In each operator, check the other operand's type first and `return NotImplemented` (don't raise) if it's wrong. Python then raises the `TypeError` for you. `__rmul__` can simply delegate to `__mul__`.
